market_summary: Nvidia's board reinstated Jensen Huang as CEO before Monday's open, 12 days after he resigned. NVDA traded about 31% higher; the Nasdaq was up about 6.7% and the S&P 500 about 4.8% mid-afternoon, ending a seven-day losing streak, with the VIX down 22%. Chips and power names led. Rates are still a headwind: the 10-year is near 4.94% and markets price about a 92% chance of a Fed hike on Dec 9. WTI fell about 2.8%, and China and Hong Kong closed lower before the US rebound. Figures are intraday, not closes.

headlines: Huang reinstated as Nvidia CEO; NVDA about +31%, Nasdaq about +6.7% Monday intraday.
Chips lead the rebound: MU +19%, MRVL +18%, TSM +15%; watchlist ALAB +21%, SKHY +20%.
SEC probe still open: Huang's closed-door House interview Dec 1, Senate hearing requested Dec 3.
Fed hike on Dec 9 still about 92% priced; RKT and LDI moved to watch.
Amazon reportedly paying about $7.5B for Decart; may land at re:Invent from Nov 30.
US GDP and PCE Wed 8:30am ET = Thu 12:30am AEDT; US closed Thu.
